880-2783-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-2783-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

643-3197-8329.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities each trigger, as Herd Baloth is both a Zombie and a Cat due to Maskwood Nexus.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on any creature you wish.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the creature token enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Repeat from step 3.

424-868-8216.description:
Cast Devouring Greed by paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Holding priority, cast Desperate Ritual by paying its splice cost, adding its effects onto Devouring Greed.
Holding priority, activate Mirror Sheen by paying {1}{U/R}{U/R}, copying Devouring Greed, which also has the effects of Desperate Ritual, targeting an opponent.
Resolve Devouring Greed, causing an opponent to lose life, and causing you to gain life and add {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

222-527-5223-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5223-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-864-2511-3125-7422.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2511-3125-7422.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Garrison Excavator.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

2457-2757-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Bard.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

3499-6723-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3499-6723-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3499-6723-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2292-6972-7754--167.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the other Mutant.
When the Mutant dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Mutant enters, X-23 triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on X-23 and the other Mutant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-6972-7754--167.notes: The chosen Mutant must have toughness 2 or greater.

360-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

4050-4871-6476-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4050-4871-6476-7487.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Zealous Lorecaster and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Zealous Lorecaster, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6283-7399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3490-4659-6283-7399.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Bogwater Lumaret indestructible.
3490-4659-6283-7399.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-3703-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1127-3152-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures with different powers.
1127-3152-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Selvala.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

586-3168-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

539-2244-4068-4803.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-2244-4068-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

654-2248-3147-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Skyshroud Ranger.
Skyshroud Ranger does not have summoning sickness.
654-2248-3147-4222.description:
Activate Skyshroud Ranger by tapping it, putting Azorius Chancery onto the battlefield from your hand.
When Azorius Chancery enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Azorius Chancery.
Activate Azorius Chancery by tapping it, adding {W}{U}.
Resolve the Azorius Chancery trigger from step 2, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Skyshroud Ranger.
Repeat.

2493-2596-3821-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{B}{B}.
2493-2596-3821-5256.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {3}{B}{B}.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake, causing target player to mill cards equal to Peregrine Drake and Archaeomancer's power.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Repeat.
If the five lands can tap to produce at least {4}{B}{B}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1182-2557-4772-5270.description:
Cast Stonecoil Serpent by paying {0}.
Stonecoil Serpent enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Samwise triggers, creating four Food artifact tokens.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing three Foods, returning Stonecoil Serpent to your hand from your graveyard.
Repeat.

854-2034-3374.notablePrerequisites: Botanical Brawler does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
854-2034-3374.description:
Activate Antler Skulkin by paying {2}, giving Botanical Brawler persist until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Botanical Brawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Botanical Brawler dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with one +1/+1 counter on it due to its first ability.
Repeat.

283-1978-2375-4474-5077.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers attached to Voltaic Construct.
Scaretiller does not have summoning sickness.
283-1978-2375-4474-5077.description:
Activate Scaretiller by tapping it, adding {1}.
Scaretiller triggers, returning Riveteers Overlook from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Riveteers Overlook enters the battlefield, causing you to sacrifice it and search your library for a basic Mountain, Swamp or Forest and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, targeting Scaretiller.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Voltaic Construct's ability, targeting Scaretiller.
Resolve the copy of Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Holding priority, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve the original Voltaic Construct's ability, untapping Scaretiller.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Decoction Module.

661-3484-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, triggering Decoction Module and Sculpting Steel, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

3000-3868-4231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three untapped creatures.
3000-3868-4231.description:
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating one Treasure, one Food, one Clue, and three 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Repeat.

2060-2854-2908-3129.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2854-2908-3129.description:
Cast Dream Stalker, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{U}.
Dream Stalker triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.
